item.title: So… You Found AWS Access Keys (Part 1)
item.description: <p>The AWS access keys are in hand... now what? In Part 1 of this blog series, we break down AWS credential types, where to find them, and how to validate and use them during a security engagement.</p>

item.title: Unpacking a laZzzy Donut
item.description: <p>Six stages. Multiple encryption layers. One static analysis. In this blog, we unpack a multi-stage malware loader combining Python obfuscation, Donut shellcode, and laZzzy PE encryption, without executing the payload.</p>

item.title: What's New in hate_crack Since 2.0
item.description: <p>You thought you knew hate_crack 👀 Well, version 2.0 changed that. In Part 1 of this latest blog series, we go through 13 new attack methods, menu restructuring, and local LLM integration.</p>

item.title: HashcatRosetta: Reading the Rosetta Stone of Password Cracking
item.description: <p>Meet HashcatRosetta—the Hashcat rule decoder you didn't know you needed. In Part 2 of this blog series, we go through how it translates, analyzes, and optimizes rule files to maximize cracking efficiency.</p>

item.title: Logging is a Discipline, Not a Switch
item.description: <p>Logging isn't a switch to flip; it's something to tune and maintain. In this blog, we outline a four-step Active Directory logging framework covering log sizing, audit policies, detection goals, and gap analysis.</p>

item.title: TrustedSec Joins the OpenAI Daybreak Defense Network
item.description: <p>We're part of OpenAI’s Daybreak Defense Network—what does that mean for our customers? Go deeper, get to the evidence faster, and make real security improvements; in this blog, Founder and CEO David Kennedy explains how.</p>

item.title: Two Config Files, Two Release Tracks, and One Very Bad Commit
item.description: <p>Some of the best infrastructure improvements start with one bad afternoon. In the final part of this blog series, we walk through the configuration, release engineering, and pre-commit guardrails that came out of it.</p>

item.title: Handling Pre-Contract FCI and CUI
item.description: <p>CMMC requirements don’t exist before a contract does and that distinction matters. In this blog, we clarify what FCI and CUI obligations apply during the pre-contract solicitation phase, and where the line actually is.</p>

item.title: Trimarc, 18 Months Later at TrustedSec
item.description: <p>Eighteen months after Trimarc joined TrustedSec, the work speaks for itself. In this blog, we reflect on Trimarc’s integration into TrustedSec and what it means for customers, services, and ongoing research.</p>

item.title: What is CUI? A Contractor’s Perspective
item.description: <p>Three questions every government contractor should be able to answer about CUI—how to identify it, when to mark it, and how to handle it correctly. In this blog, we answer all three from a contractor’s perspective.</p>
